# Company research: Northwind Software (fictional)

Source for every line: examples/sample-posting.txt (the demo's only employer source; Northwind is fictional, so there is no website to cite).

- Northwind Software makes Compass, a support-queue product that shows team leads where routing delays begin.
- Northwind says its design priority is helping leads correct queue problems before customers need to follow up.
- The role runs a 10-person customer support team and reports weekly to the Head of Customer Experience.
